TAP
Description
These commands allows you to manage the Threat Analytics Platform.
Command List
TAP::action
- Returns or updates security token action.
TAP::config
- Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned TAP Application.
TAP::insight
- Accumulates or sends key:value pairs to TAP, returns token
TAP::insight_requested
- TAP requests insight flag
TAP::score
- Returns or updates risk score.
Event List
TAP_REQUEST
- Triggered once security token obtained.
